subject.title: docs(durable): propose durable core runtime boundary and validation plan

question: Should this new durable core runtime RFC become the canonical public architecture doc for the open durable-runtime stack, replace the older RFC at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98717, or be closed/narrowed?
rationale: The patch is docs-only, but accepting it would publish a core runtime architecture direction and it overlaps an existing open durable-runtime RFC plus stacked implementation PRs.

options.title: Choose one canonical RFC
options.body: Select either this PR or the existing durable-runtime RFC as the review target, then require the contributor to fold useful text into that branch and update docs metadata before merge.

options.title: Accept this narrower stack
options.body: If maintainers prefer the new five-part durable-core stack, repair the docs metadata and then retarget or close the older overlapping durable-runtime PRs.

options.title: Pause or reject core direction
options.body: If durable core runtime is not wanted in OpenClaw core now, close or narrow this stack with the core/plugin/product-boundary rationale.

recommendation.title: Choose one canonical RFC
recommendation.body: Select either this PR or the existing durable-runtime RFC as the review target, then require the contributor to fold useful text into that branch and update docs metadata before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is a core product/architecture boundary and current main history also routes the specs/docs pattern through Peter Steinberger.
